entities.name: Malik Beyleroğlu
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Malik Beyleroğlu is a former amateur boxer from Turkey(Azerbaijani origin), born in the Azerbaijan Soviet Socialist Republic, Soviet Union. At the 1996 Summer Olympics, he won the silver medal in the men's middleweight division. In the final, he was defeated by Ariel Hernández of Cuba.
